input.free_text_description: This system is a e-commerce platform that serves Customer, Admin roles. It manages core business objects including order, order item, stock model, product. The platform provides capabilities for cache, cart, cart. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include authentication functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a Customer, I want to create and manage order records, so that I can track and organize order data effectively.
As a Customer, I want to create and manage order item records, so that I can track and organize order item data effectively.
As a Customer, I want to create and manage stock model records, so that I can track and organize stock model data effectively.
As a Customer, I want to create and manage product records, so that I can track and organize product data effectively.
